text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[Appmon] trait: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 of this Digimon's link cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn.

qa.question: Can I also activate this card's link effect by trashing this card itself when it's a link card?

I used and have a Digimon that has multiple link cards including this card.
Can I use this card's Link effect to trash one of that Digimon's link cards other than this card?
